name: Luca Faloni
why: Cashmere from Cariaggi and linen knit in Brescia — the same Italian suppliers the luxury houses use, sold direct without the markup.
origin: Luca Faloni, London, 2014 — Italian cloth, direct, with every mill named.
opview: States its case plainly: the same Italian mills the luxury houses use, without the markup.

onething.n: direct — the sky blue Portofino, verified

notes.cashmere: the same Cariaggi spinner as Cucinelli, at a quarter of the price
notes.linen: Brescia-knit linen jersey with an honest aloe finish
notes.ital: the entire pitch is Italy, shipped direct
notes.boat: Linen and cashmere aimed squarely at the Italian coast — Portofino more than Cowes. The boat is a setting here rather than an activity.
